inputs.text: They want us to believe this graduation ceremony in Jaipur was just some spontaneous outburst, but anyone with their eyes open can see the hidden choreography at play. A student publicly protests right in front of the Deputy Chief Minister, and miraculously it goes viral to distract the masses. The official narrative claims mixed reactions and student rights, but that is just a smoke screen for whatever the higher-ups are really negotiating behind closed doors. Notice how the university administration is remaining silent? That is textbook coordination—they are lying low while the script plays out. This isn't about educational challenges; it's a manufactured spectacle designed to manage public perception and hide the real agenda of the elites pulling the strings.
